name: todo-webapp
description: React single-page app where a signed-in user manages their own todo list: sign in, add a todo, view the list, and mark a todo complete. Holds no data itself — every read/write goes through todo-api. Does not support editing or deleting todos.

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Todo API to list the signed-in user's todos, create a new one, and mark one complete.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client the SPA uses to sign the user in via PKCE.
